Description:
The iFlow carries the essence of the original Flow hard board into a refined inflatable form. Designed for downwinds, paddling, and light wind wing or parawing, it’s tuned for maximum glide and effortless early lift, even in marginal conditions.

Its narrow outline and extended length let the board slip through the water with minimal resistance. Whether you’re chasing long-distance runs or calm-water takeoffs, the iFlow keeps you in motion with less effort and earlier foil engagement.

At its core, the Fusion Composite Dropstitch construction, capable of holding pressure up to 20 PSI, and extra-long carbon foil connector plate deliver the stiffness and control close to rigid boards. The sharp rear rail ensures clean water release, while the thick tail and rounded rails improve pre-lift stability and glide. The result is a board that performs efficiently before takeoff and maintains composure through transitions.

The iFlow gives you more time in the air and less fatigue in your body. Whether you're linking bumps under a parawing or paddling into small swell, it helps you stay connected, fluid, and in control.

The board features a clean deck layout with footstrap (not included) inserts, a bi-directional groove EVA pad for all-conditions grip, and a central carry handle integrated into the foil plate. It packs down into a compact, ergonomic backpack with padded shoulder straps and Unifiber Wheel Base compatibility, making it easy to transport and store.

From remote coastlines to inland wind shadows, the iFlow is your lightweight glide-first travel companion. Built for riders with intention, it’s a board that unlocks new terrain without compromise.

Its mid-length outline and recessed bottom contour reduce drag from the hydrofoil plate, helping you lift off earlier and glide more efficiently. A subtle kick tail boosts pop during take-off, while the recessed deck creates balanced control at speed, with your front foot positioned slightly higher for a natural riding stance. Each size is individually engineered to match different skill levels, from large volumes that offer stability for newer riders to compact shapes that reward experienced foilers with a more dynamic feel.

Available in two constructions — a cost-effective fiberglass layup and a carbon build for riders who want lighter weight and increased stiffness.

The Aeryn iFlux brings the versatility of our original Flux into a lightweight, inflatable platform without sacrificing control or response. Designed for riders who want a single board to handle freeride, parawing, and light downwind sessions, the iFlux offers the same balanced ride feel in a compact, portable package.

Built with Fusion Composite Dropstitch construction and capable of holding pressure up to 20 PSI, the board stays impressively stiff underfoot, delivering clean feedback and early lift on foil. The extended carbon foil plate increases torsional rigidity, giving the foil a more direct connection and improving overall control, especially during transitions and carving. A sharp rear rail helps release water cleanly, making takeoffs smoother and reducing lateral drift.

The iFlux features a clean deck layout with footstrap (not included) inserts, a bi-directional groove EVA pad for all-conditions grip, and a central carry handle integrated into the foil plate. It packs down into a compact, ergonomic backpack with padded shoulder straps and Unifiber Wheel Base compatibility, making it easy to transport and store.

From first sessions to fluid progression, the iFlux is designed to simplify your gear while keeping performance front and center.

The Surge is a dedicated wingfoiling board engineered for riders who want to push their limits in higher wind, freestyle, and aggressive carving. Shorter and wider than the Flow and Flux, its compact outline delivers instant response whether you’re jumping, landing, or driving hard through turns.

A recessed bottom reduces drag from the hydrofoil plate, while the improved deck profile positions your front foot slightly higher to maximize control at speed and during landings. The concave deck keeps thickness minimal underfoot, giving you direct, precise feedback from the foil. Even with its reduced length, the volume distribution toward the tail improves balance and stability before take-off, so you can commit fully to your next move.

Each size is designed independently to achieve the right balance of inertia, responsiveness, and control. Larger volumes suit newer riders seeking stability, while smaller sizes under 80L cater to intermediate and expert foilers chasing a more dynamic feel.

Product name: Aeryn Board Trainer Inflatable 20 PSI - 7'8 Board Only
Description:
The Aeryn iTrainer is designed for structured, step-by-step wingfoil instruction. From first-time wing handling to successful flights, it supports every phase of learning in a stable, progressive, and low-stress format.

Riders begin with two integrated fins — one placed in front, one behind the foil mount — to minimize drift and help the board track upwind. This lets students learn balance and wing control before introducing the added challenge of flying.

When it’s time to take off, the fins are removed and a foil can be mounted directly into the extra-long carbon plate. The foot position remains unchanged, making the transition from floating to flying smooth and intuitive.

The wide, rounded nose provides outstanding stability and helps reduce nosedives or harsh touchdowns. A balanced deck and moderate tail width help students maintain a steady stance, while the board’s pin tail improves glide and water release during takeoff.

Made with Fusion Composite Dropstitch, capable of holding pressure up to 20 PSI, and a carbon foil connector plate, the iTrainer is stiff, responsive, and durable enough for repeated use in any learning environment. The bi-directional-groove EVA deck pad ensures solid grip, improving rider control whether barefoot or in booties.

Whether in group classes or private lessons, the iTrainer gives students the right tools to build confidence from day one and carry it into every flight after.

Product name: Aeryn Foil Back Fuselage Extension Carbon + 22 = 54
Description:
Carbon tow preg extensions for the Modular Fuselage System.

The Modular Fuselage System is made of two parts: a front connection and a tail extension. Choose from three front connection types—Alloy, Carbon, or Titanium—and pair it with one of four carbon extension lengths to define exactly how your foil responds.

Shorter extensions deliver quicker transitions and a more dynamic feel for carving and freestyle. Longer extensions add tracking and stability, ideal for downwind runs or when you want a steadier ride.

The Alloy/Carbon combination offers an affordable, reliable platform for beginner and intermediate riders.

Carbon/Carbon is designed for intermediate to expert riders seeking a lighter setup with balanced handling.

Titanium/Carbon brings a premium finish and elevated responsiveness for riders focused on performance and refined design.

Whether you want maximum control, smoother pumping, or a balanced all-around setup, this modular system gives you the flexibility to fine-tune your foil around your ride—not the other way around

Description:
Carbon tow preg extensions for the Modular Fuselage System.

The Modular Fuselage System is made of two parts: a front connection and a tail extension. Choose from three front connection types—Alloy, Carbon, or Titanium—and pair it with one of four carbon extension lengths to define exactly how your foil responds.

Shorter extensions deliver quicker transitions and a more dynamic feel for carving and freestyle. Longer extensions add tracking and stability, ideal for downwind runs or when you want a steadier ride.

The Alloy/Carbon combination offers an affordable, reliable platform for beginner and intermediate riders.

Carbon/Carbon is designed for intermediate to expert riders seeking a lighter setup with balanced handling.

Titanium/Carbon brings a premium finish and elevated responsiveness for riders focused on performance and refined design.

Whether you want maximum control, smoother pumping, or a balanced all-around setup, this modular system gives you the flexibility to fine-tune your foil around your ride—not the other way around

The Navigator is Aeryn’s most accessible and adaptable foil system — a Medium Aspect setup made for riders who want clarity, comfort, and confidence from their first session to their next breakthrough. It’s not about pushing harder — it’s about progressing smarter.

With a forgiving ride feel, steady lift, and predictable handling at lower speeds, the Navigator gives you the space to focus on timing, flow, and positioning without being overpowered or rushed. The long alloy fuselage and wide-span stabilizer work together to keep things smooth, steady, and on track through every transition.

Whether you're linking your first jibes or exploring new wind angles, the Navigator stays composed underfoot, giving you consistent feedback and precise control when you need it most.

If you’re aiming for balance and steady progress over peak performance, the Navigator is your reliable choice.

The Aeryn Stratos HM is a high-aspect foil system built for riders who value glide, control, and a confident connection to the water. Designed to work across disciplines—from wing foiling to downwind—it delivers a direct, composed ride that stays responsive even when fully powered.

Constructed primarily from High Modulus carbon, the system maintains exceptional stiffness and low flex, giving you a precise, predictable feel under your feet. A titanium front fuselage adds durability and stability where it matters most, while the carbon rear section keeps the ride light and responsive. Together, this balanced construction improves handling at speed, supports efficient pumping, and helps the foil hold the line through gusts and changing conditions.

On the water, the Stratos HM feels clean and intentional. It builds speed smoothly, holds its line without hesitation, and rewards a controlled, flowing riding style. Whether you’re linking bumps on a downwind run, extending light-wind sessions, or refining a fast freeride setup, the foil remains stable, efficient, and easy to trust.

Product name: Aeryn Pocket Wing P1 Coral Red 3.0
Description:
Imagine carving effortlessly downwind, unbound by the limitations of traditional inflatable wings or complex bridle setups. The Aeryn P1 Pocket Wing takes you further—upwind in a breeze, downwind riding the swell—with unparalleled ease.

This is more than a wing; it's a revolution in windfoiling. Designed by the same innovators behind two decades of high-performance foil kites for Peter Lynn and PLKB, the P1 brings simplicity and performance to every session.
Ultra-light and ready to launch in seconds, the P1 is free of unnecessary complexities—just throw it into the wind, and you're on your way. And when you’re ready to focus solely on your ride, it packs away effortlessly, leaving you free to experience the elements without distraction.
Ready to experience the freedom of breaking away from traditional setups? The Aeryn P1 invites you to redefine what's possible in watersport foiling.

This is more than a wing; it's a revolution in windfoiling. Designed by the same innovators behind two decades of high-performance foil kites for Peter Lynn and PLKB, the P1 brings simplicity and performance to every session.
Ultra-light and ready to launch in seconds, the P1 is free of unnecessary complexities—just throw it into the wind, and you're on your way. And when you’re ready to focus solely on your ride, it packs away effortlessly, leaving you free to experience the elements without distraction.
Ready to experience the freedom of breaking away from traditional setups? The Aeryn P1 invites you to redefine what's possible in watersport foiling.

Description:
The Aeryn X1 is built for riders who want intuitive handling without sacrificing speed. Lightweight, responsive, and stable at pace, it adapts to your style whether you're carving clean lines, cruising in open water, or pushing for speed across long reaches. Its low-drag profile and forward-focused power deliver efficient acceleration, reliable top-end control, and precise handling across a full range of conditions. It stays smooth through gusts, composed in transitions, and confidently locked in at speed.

Inflated to 7 PSI in the leading edge and 8 PSI in the strut, the X1 holds crisp structural tension. Pumping feels immediate, lift comes early, and once on foil, the wing tracks fast and clean with minimal rider input. It rewards subtle shifts in trim and lets you focus on glide and flow without constant correction.

Equipped with a boom, the X1 gives you full freedom of hand placement and maximum control through every phase of the ride. Whether you're adjusting trim during long runs, transitioning through jibes, or lining up on a wave face, the boom offers a stable, reactive grip that stays intuitive under pressure.

Whether you're building confidence or riding at your limit, the X1 delivers a clean, efficient connection between rider, wing, and water. It’s fast when you need it, fluid when you want it, and always in control.

Product name: Aeryn Wing X1 Dyneema Ocean Blue 4.0
Description:
The Aeryn X1 Dyneema Edition takes the clean handling and balanced drive of the original X1 and pushes it further. Built for riders who want a faster, more responsive feel, this version features a high-tenacity Dyneema laminate canopy that reduces stretch, sharpens control, and keeps the wing performing at its peak over time. Every input translates directly into motion, and the wing maintains its shape under pressure—even in heavy gusts or aggressive maneuvers.

The reduced weight isn’t just noticeable on the beach. On the water, the Dyneema Edition feels lighter in the hands, better balanced through transitions, and quicker to respond across the full range of motion. Acceleration comes easier, fatigue drops off, and long sessions stay fluid and efficient from start to finish.

Equipped with a carbon boom, the Dyneema Edition offers full freedom of hand placement with a rigid, direct connection to the wing. Whether you're trimming at speed, carving turns, or threading through gusty conditions, the boom keeps handling sharp and predictable without compromise.

For riders who want the lightest, most precise ride possible—without sacrificing durability or structure—the Dyneema Edition delivers a new level of control. It’s the same wing at its core, just tighter, faster, and built to push further.

Extremely light and stable, the Loftsails Airscape is a dual-purpose design that delivers explosive freestyle and super-easy freeride foiling.

As a freestyle sail, Airscape goes neutral on demand and can be powered up rapidly. This is aided by a Dacron luff panel and specific design parameters.

With its dual Dacron head panels, 2 mil tri-axial upper body and triple reinforced foot, the Airscape is ultra-light and can cope with the demands of radical freestyle moves.

New leech outlines and a narrowed head width take the maneuverability of Airscape to a higher level.

The same qualities that make Airscape a great freestyle sail perfectly translate into exceptionally easy and stable freeride foil performance. The high aspect ratio balances the low drag hydrofoil underneath.

Smaller frame of the Airscape design perfectly complements the Skyscape’s range of bigger sizes.

Product name: Anti-Weed Lessacher Weed Blade G10 24 cm Power Box
Description: Our newest weapon to dodge the "evil green". We again teamed-up with ‘Mr. Weed-Slasher’ - Wolfgang Lessacher - and created a lethal anti-weed line for spots infested with weed. The stiff G10 'asymmetrical' profile’s a true power house, giving ideal lift characteristics for maximum speed and enjoyment.As the former FWD model this latest version has the leading edge moved slightly forward for even better performance of this already very successful range of Anti-Weed fins. The Weed Blade will benefit additional those who are looking for "normal" fin behaviour while being capable of higher speeds compared to it's FWD predecessor. Very important: choose this fin 8-10 cm. shorter than you’d normally use for the best experience.
Pro #1: Antiweed fins are all about the "least bad solution"

The Aviator is an all-round wing with an exceptional wind range. Designed for riders looking for a balanced and versatile wing, it remains stable and responsive when cruising, wave riding or hitting big airs.

When flagged out the Aviator drifts smoothly without getting in the way. Yet, even when completely depowered, the wing maintains its responsive nature, switching from drift to acceleration as the rider commands.

An elliptical leading-edge shape and an S-shaped strut provide balanced weight and power distribution. Separate filler valves allow for precise inflation control. The Aviator’s handles - ergonomically shaped and positioned for efficient power delivery - reduce fatigue on the forearms and allow for longer sessions.

The aspect ratio of the Aviator varies through the size range so that the wing feels the same in all conditions.

The Blackline Hydrofoil Bag is a perfect companion for carrying hydrofoils and essential spares on your next adventure.

With ample space, the bag effortlessly accommodates up to x3 front wings, x2 stabilizers, x2 fuselages, x2 masts, and any other necessary gear. The bag's interior features dedicated placeholders and dividers, allowing you to organize your foil components conveniently and securely. The positions of the placeholders can be easily adjusted within the bag and affixed with velcro attachments. By using these placeholders, each individual component remains firmly in its designated place, preventing any movement during transport.

In addition to the placeholders, the Hydrofoil Bag features a hardware wallet. This wallet can be detached from the bag, for better access to necessary screws and tools during foil assembly.

To shield its valuable contents from external impacts, the outer shell of the Hydrofoil bag is padded with 10mm of EPE foam. The interior dividers are also padded with 6mm of EPE foam to safeguard the components from each other.

The Hydrofoil Bag is offered in two sizes: the smaller version accommodates parts up to a maximum length/span of 1100mm, while the larger variant comfortably fits items up to 1350mm.

For your convenience, both bag sizes are equipped with the option of a detachable shoulder strap.
Pro #1: Optional shoulder strap can be attached to the carry bag

Description:
Easily transport all your wing foil gear in one convenient Blackline Wingfoil Board-Quiverbag!

Designed with ample space to fit one board, a complete hydrofoil set, 2 wings, a wetsuit, a helmet, and various accessories, this bag ensures your gear travels securely and remains well-protected.

The board compartment is cushioned with 10mm of EPE foam padding, providing robust protection. A specialized divider allows you to easily reach the board without disturbing the rest of the equipment. The divider, padded with 6mm foam, also prevents the board and foil components from touching and damaging each other.

Dedicated placeholders securely hold each foil part in place, preventing any shifting during transport. The positions of the placeholders can be easily adjusted and affixed with velcro attachments within the bag.

In addition to the placeholders, the bag features a hardware wallet. This wallet can be detached from the bag for better access to necessary screws and tools during foil assembly.

Blackline Wingfoil Board-Quiverbag is available in three sizes: 155x65, 170x75, and 185x85 (inner dimensions). The 155x65 size fits within most airlines' checked luggage allowance, sparing you from additional baggage fees.

For your convenience, all bag sizes can be equipped with a detachable shoulder strap and are compatible with Unifiber's Optional Wheel Base.
Pro #1: Optional shoulder strap can be attached to the carry bag
Pro #2: Compatible with Unifiber's Optional Wheel Base

Description:
The FormulaBlade returns in limited production for 2026, a proven design built with one purpose: maximum efficiency and speed on dedicated upwind and downwind Formula racing courses.

With a strong legacy shaped through years of refinement and elite-level competition, the Formulablade track record speaks for itself. This sail has powered riders like Dennis Littel to ten consecutive national titles, and Fernando Martinez to six Spanish championships.

For 2026, the Formulablade builds on that foundation with a series of meaningful updates that further enhance control, acceleration, and aerodynamic efficiency. A higher aspect ratio and refined shaping reduce drag, while a slightly lowered foot improves control and helps riders stay locked in across a wide range of angles.

Much like the Racingblade, the Formulablade shares the same performance-driven construction DNA. Carefully tuned battens with longer rod sections and rear-shifted tube segments create a shallow, efficient entry profile that promotes smooth rotation and clean airflow. Side-alternating X-Ply batten pockets help maintain a consistent sail shape and neutral rotation character even under heavy load.

The TekCam 3 system, now 35% lighter, improves cam rotation while supporting higher batten angles. This helps preserve the sail’s refined profile and responsive handling. The mast sleeve has a dual-layer stretch-resistant zone just behind the mast, made from 2-mil quad-axial X-Ply and IYU250 woven laminate, and runs from head to tack, keeping the mast sleeve structurally sound season after season. A 50 mm triple-stitched center sleeve seam adds further durability under repeated rigging and tension.

Additional features include dual Kevlar 5.0 mil tri-axial laminate clew radials for balanced load distribution and increased drive, plus 5.0 mil foot panels for added durability in high-wear zones. The upper body uses 4.0 mil bi-ply laminate for excellent UV resistance and long-term shape retention.

Finished in Loftsails’ clean and functional minimalism graphic, the FormulaBlade 2026 keeps overall weight low and shifts the center of gravity downward, boosting reactivity and confidence across every reach and gybe.

Whether you're embarking on a journey abroad or heading to your local windsurfing spot, your gear needs to arrive safe and ready for action.

Our Pro Luxury boardbag range, consisting of 11 different sizes, is tailored to provide optimal protection for your windsurfing boards.

A true wave catcher and crafted in the style of a surf longboard, the Breeze is designed to shine where its more radical cousins struggle – in super light and marginal winds.

The increased length allows for remarkably early take-offs even in ultra-light wind. Combined with the additional volume, the board can go over the white water smoother and without exhausting the rider.

All Breeze sizes feature a unique step tail feature. When on the wave, it functionally reduces the effective length of the board by almost 30 cm. This transition dramatically changes the board's behavior on the wave, making it react like a shorter board, enabling precise and extended bottom turns at full speed.

The board's bottom includes a prominent V shape, allowing the rider to roll from rail to rail with ease. Sharp turns are notably smooth, adding to the agility of the board when compared to a more classic wave board.

The Breeze boards come with a versatile fin setup, offering the option of using three fins or a single fin for freeriding or a laid-back cruising session.

A genuine wave-catcher, the Breeze is inspired by classic surf longboards and comes alive in conditions where more radical shapes struggle. Ultra-light winds become an opportunity rather than a limitation.

Its extended length unlocks impressively early take-offs, letting you glide across marginal conditions without hesitation. The added volume carries you smoothly over white water, sparing your energy for the ride itself.

When it’s time to turn, the Breeze reveals a hidden talent. Each size is equipped with the distinctive step tail, cleverly reducing the board’s effective length by nearly 30 cm when engaged on a wave. The result is a striking transformation: longboard glide on the approach, shortboard precision as you drive through carving bottom turns.

Underneath, a pronounced V-shaped hull encourages effortless rail-to-rail transitions. Whether you’re tracing sweeping arcs or quick directional changes, the board feels agile and composed.

A versatile fin configuration rounds out the package. Choose a thruster setup for wave riding or switch to a single fin for relaxed freeride sessions and casual cruising.

Product name: Elite Carbon Boom V2 140-200 Slim IWT - Ergo Head
Description:
The Elite Carbon Boom V2 is the lightest and stiffest boom in the range. Built for competitive and high-end performance sailing, it delivers the most direct feedback between rider and sail, whether charging in a straight line, accelerating in a gust, or landing hard in messy chop.

Custom-manufactured from the highest-grade pre-preg carbon, the boom holds its shape under severe load — helping the rig maintain its profile even in powered conditions.

Across the full range — from 140 to 250 — every model features a wide tail designed to support modern sail outlines and deeper profiles without distortion.

The slim grip of the 140 model feels natural and controlled in the hands. The reduced diameter eases the load on your forearms, making it ideal for waves and bump and jump sessions where aggressive conditions can quickly lead to fatigue. The wide tail allows deeper profiles, including cam and foil sails, to set correctly — maintaining draft stability and control when fully powered.

The larger Outside Wide Tail sizes are tuned for freeride and race setups, minimising back-end swing weight while balancing bigger rigs. The result is a lighter feel through transitions and greater control at speed.

Every Elite Carbon Boom V2 boom features a pulley block for smooth, precise trim adjustments.

The Elite Carbon Boom V2 is available with a choice of two boom heads:
  • Modular Boom Head — the go-to choice for maximum stiffness and direct mast connection.

  • Ergo Boom Head — a classic single-hinge lever for fast, familiar rigging.

Description:
When the priority is the most direct connection between rider and sail, the Modular Boom Head delivers it. Its two-collar construction wraps evenly around the mast, distributing rig loads across the full contact area rather than concentrating them at a single point — resulting in a firm, precise connection that transmits input cleanly and holds its position under load.

Each collar is independently adjustable via ClamCleat® tensioners, allowing fine-tuning for both SDM and RDM masts. The system works with the mast's natural bend curve rather than against it, minimising play and keeping power transfer direct and consistent throughout the session.

The "Direct Fit & Twist" interface makes swapping boom heads a matter of seconds. HD and Elite models accept optional Performance Bolts for riders who want every last percentage of stiffness. Fully compatible with all Unifiber Essentials, HD, and Elite boom bodies — components can be mixed, matched, and replaced individually as needed.

Essentials and HD models are supplied with 4.0mm pre-stretched polyester ropes, while the Elite version features 3.8mm Dyneema ropes.

The Modular Boom Head is available as a standalone or as the boom head of choice when ordering a new Unifiber boom.

Prefer the simplicity of a classic single-hinge boom head? Consider the Unifiber Ergo Boom Head instead.
Pro #1: Direct Fit & Twist functionality requires first-time practice

Product name: Elite RDM V2 Carbon Mast Extension (U-Pin) 32
Description:
RDM Elite V2 Carbon Mast Extension design is about maximizing both performance and durability.

Through heavy chop, racecourse or waves, Elite V2 Carbon Extension maintains the integrity of your rig.

The pre-preg carbon tube keeps the weight low and gives a responsive feel to your rig. The connection between the carbon tube and the stainless steel base of the extension is direct and stiff.

Operating the open-and-slide adjustment collar is easy and can be done even with one hand.

The extension's base is flat with no grooves or protrusions, making rigging bare-foot friendly.
Pro #1: 2 pulleys
Pro #2: Carbon tube is more vulnerable to impact damage. So avoid dropping this mast extension on the ground.

Product name: Elite SDM V2 Carbon Mast Extension (U-Pin) 32
Description:
SDM Elite V2 Carbon Mast Extension design is about maximizing both performance and durability.

Whether you are blasting through heavy chop or setting new speed records, Elite V2 Carbon Extension maintains the integrity of your rig.

Its 3-pulley configuration offers a maximum ratio of 8:1, making it perfect for race sail designs that require very high downhaul tensions.

The pre-preg carbon tube keeps the weight low and gives a responsive feel to your rig. The connection between the carbon tube and the stainless steel base of the extension is direct and stiff.

Operating the open-and-slide adjustment collar is easy and can be done even with one hand.

The extension's base is flat with no grooves or protrusions, making rigging bare-foot friendly.
Pro #1: Carbon tube is more vulnerable to impact damage. So avoid dropping this mast extension on the ground.

Description:
The Energy HP is all about accessible, efficient paddleboarding for anyone who wants to spend more time enjoying the water and less time figuring things out. This inflatable SUP delivers a smooth glide, excellent balance, and easy to maneuver. Whether you're cruising calm lakes or exploring slow rivers, it’s your go-to board that is easy to store and transport.

A carefully tuned outline combines a pintail for smooth displacement with a wide nose and forward max beam for added stability. This design helps reduce the need to constantly switch paddle sides, keeping your motion efficient and relaxed. Thanks to the fin’s forward position, turning is easier too—you stay centred without shifting your weight to the tail.

A bungee net on the nose provides room for your essentials, while the EVA deck pad features a directional-groove pattern for solid grip underfoot.

The High Pressure (HP) build uses Fusion Composite Dropstitch, offering excellent stiffness, responsiveness, and glide. It inflates up to 20 psi and comes with an ergonomic backpack (wheel base compatible) and a double-action pump for quick, hassle-free inflation
Pro #1: Double-Action Pump

Description:
Formerly known as the Skyscape, the Loftsails 2026 Escape reflects years of fine-tuning, excellent test results, and a growing appreciation for just how versatile this design has become. Originally developed as a dedicated freefoil sail, Escape has proven equally capable on a fin, delivering smooth freeride handling and even freerace performance when the wind picks up.

With a slightly higher aspect ratio and shorter boom, Escape balances the low drag of a hydrofoil while maintaining crisp responsiveness underfoot. Its no-cam layout and lightweight construction make transitions effortless and help keep your board precisely trimmed through every maneuver.

For 2026, refinements across nearly every detail sharpen Escape’s all-round capabilities. Rescheduled luff curves and batten angle re-orientation improve balance and lower the sail’s center of gravity, creating a more neutral feel in the hands. A lower foot profile increases control and aerodynamic efficiency when fully powered, while the new 30mm mast panel seam and 5mil foot panels boost durability in demanding sessions.

Escape’s shape and trim range remain one of its strongest suits. New 2026 luff curves and finely tuned horizontal shaping induce an enormous tuning range, adapting easily to shifting conditions. Double clew eyelets add further to the sail’s wind range, allowing each size to continue performing across a broad wind spectrum.

When riding on a fin in lighter winds, Escape rewards an active approach, responding to precise sail work and pumping to generate early planing. But as soon as it powers up, the sail transforms—delivering stability, speed, and surprising freerace drive.

Finished in a clean, functional minimalism graphic that sheds excess materials and lowers the sail’s weight center, the Escape 2026 is ready to unlock freeride freedom and foiling flight, whenever and however you choose to ride.

Pre-production Escape HD Blue 2026/27.

Do note that the specs are preliminary only and might differ from the specifications of the production product.

The Essentials Alloy Boom is the natural first boom for novices and a reliable choice for recreational windsurfers.

T8 alloy monocoque construction reduces play and improves durability compared to traditional three-piece booms, while the modern outline and slightly wider tail suits all types of sailing.

The 140 and 160 sizes feature a Loop & Go system for quick and easy rigging. The 180 and 200 sizes feature wider tails to accommodate bigger sails with deeper profiles, and include a pulley block for smooth and precise trimming.

The Essentials Alloy Boom is available with a choice of two boom heads:
  • Modular Boom Head — the go-to choice for maximum stiffness and direct mast connection.

  • Ergo Boom Head — a classic single-hinge lever for fast, familiar rigging.
Pro #1: Standard wall thickness slightly less stiff and durable compared to HD (Heavy Duty) wall thickness models
Pro #2: Optional performance bolts not included with Essentials Modular Boom Head

T8 alloy monocoque construction keeps play to a minimum and holds up through regular use. The modern outline and slightly wider tail suits bump & jump and freeride sailing alike.

The 140 and 160 sizes feature a Loop & Go system for quick and easy rigging. The 180 size features a wider tail to accommodate bigger sails with deeper profiles, and includes a pulley block for smooth and precise trimming.

The Essentials Alloy Boom Tapered is available with a choice of two boom heads:
  • Modular Boom Head — the go-to choice for maximum stiffness and direct mast connection.

  • Ergo Boom Head — a classic single-hinge lever for fast, familiar rigging.
Pro #1: Optional performance bolts not included with Essentials Modular Boom Head
Con #1: Standard wall thickness is slightly less stiff and durable compared to non-tapered Essentials booms

Description:
The Ergo Boom Head brings a classic single-hinge lever into the Unifiber boom range, delivering fast and intuitive rigging. Whether setting up on the beach or making adjustments during a session, the mechanism feels familiar and easy to operate.

Supplied RDM and SDM adapters ensure the correct fit for each mast diameter and reduce point load pressure on the mast. The result is a secure, comfortable connection that holds up across seasons of regular use.

At 20% lighter than the previous generation, the Ergo is fully compatible with all Unifiber Essentials, HD, and Elite boom bodies.

Essentials and HD models are supplied with 4.0mm pre-stretched polyester ropes, while the Elite version features 3.8mm Dyneema ropes.

The Ergo Boom Head is available as a standalone or as the boom head of choice when ordering a new Unifiber boom.

Looking for maximum stiffness and the most direct power transfer? Consider the Modular Boom Head instead.
Pro #1: Supplied as kit that requires assembly

Description:
When the priority is the most direct connection between rider and sail, the Modular Boom Head delivers it. Its two-collar construction wraps evenly around the mast, distributing rig loads across the full contact area rather than concentrating them at a single point — resulting in a firm, precise connection that transmits input cleanly and holds its position under load.

Each collar is independently adjustable via ClamCleat® tensioners, allowing fine-tuning for both SDM and RDM masts. The system works with the mast's natural bend curve rather than against it, minimising play and keeping power transfer direct and consistent throughout the session.

The "Direct Fit & Twist" interface makes swapping boom heads a matter of seconds. HD and Elite models accept optional Performance Bolts for riders who want every last percentage of stiffness. Fully compatible with all Unifiber Essentials, HD, and Elite boom bodies — components can be mixed, matched, and replaced individually as needed.

Essentials and HD models are supplied with 4.0mm pre-stretched polyester ropes, while the Elite version features 3.8mm Dyneema ropes.

The Modular Boom Head is available as a standalone or as the boom head of choice when ordering a new Unifiber boom.

Prefer the simplicity of a classic single-hinge boom head? Consider the Unifiber Ergo Boom Head instead.
Pro #1: Direct Fit & Twist functionality requires first-time practice

Description:
Serving as an entry point into the Unifiber range of high-end masts, Essentials C50 RDM masts strike a good balance between value and quality. Highly recommended for recreational windsurfing, they are the number one choice for beginner and weekend warrior sailors.

Pre-preg manufacturing technology and a lower carbon to fiberglass ratio deliver outstanding durability to withstand heavy use.

The Essentials C50 RDM mast range is introduced in three new specialized curves:
  • Constant Curve — A 'classic' constant curve. Balanced and versatile, with the curve profile that has been preferred by many sailmakers for decades.
  • Constant FL Curve — A modern-day flex top with a little more flexing in the centre.
  • Constant FH Curve — Flexes in the top as much as the Green Curve but is a little stiffer in the centre, resulting in a very fluent curve.

Please check our Mast Selector tool to find out what mast curve works best for your rig.

The Experience TR rig is designed to be a dependable choice for schools, clubs, and centres guiding beginners from their first steps on the board through to confident planing. Many newcomers struggle to bridge the gap between an entry-level Dacron sail and the responsive feel of a fully-battened rig. The Experience TR helps smooth that transition with a design that supports steady progression.

This fully-battened Dacron sail features a deep, well-defined profile in the lower section, delivering stable drive and clear feedback when the wind is light. As conditions build, it can be easily tuned with downhaul and outhaul adjustments to regulate leech tension and extend the usable wind range—ideal for adapting to changing weather and varying skill levels.

Experience TR rigs are trimmed and rigged just like modern no-cam sails, so beginners become familiar early on with the same rigging techniques they’ll use as they advance.

High-quality Dacron and a robust PVC window make the sail exceptionally durable and resilient, with reinforcements at all key wear points to withstand heavy use in school environments. Each size is colour-coded, making it easy to identify on the water and organise groups of learners.

Compared to the Swing rig, the Experience TR delivers greater stability and drive in stronger winds. While the deep profile still provides clear feedback between powering and depowering, the transition feels more progressive and controlled—helping beginners build confidence session after session.

This fully-battened Dacron sail features a deep, well-defined profile in the lower section, delivering stable drive and clear feedback when the wind is light. As conditions build, it can be easily tuned with downhaul and outhaul adjustments to regulate leech tension and extend the usable wind range—ideal for adapting to changing weather and varying skill levels.

Experience TR rigs are trimmed and rigged just like modern no-cam sails, so beginners become familiar early on with the same rigging techniques they’ll use as they advance.

High-quality Dacron and a robust PVC window make the sail exceptionally durable and resilient, with reinforcements at all key wear points to withstand heavy use in school environments. Each size is colour-coded, making it easy to identify on the water and organise groups of learners.

Smaller sizes from 1.0 to 2.5 square metres come with a durable epoxy mast, with an aluminium option available for a lighter weight. The supplied boom includes harness line markers for faster, more consistent setup, and a rotating boom head ensures a secure connection at any boom height.

Compared to the Swing rig, the Experience TR delivers greater stability and drive in stronger winds. While the deep profile still provides clear feedback between powering and depowering, the transition feels more progressive and controlled—helping beginners build confidence session after session.

Our Explore paddle is for experienced paddlers looking to get the most bang for their buck.

With a tough fiberglass shaft and reinforced fiberglass blade, the paddle naturally flexes under load. The blade is efficient as it enters and leaves water, allowing rider to stroke smoothly and reducing the load on back and shoulders.

The EVA grip over the entire shaft makes the paddle comfortable to hold, protects your board, and increases the buoyancy of the paddle.

An anti-twist system keeps the blade and shaft perfectly aligned.

The Freefoil embodies the spirit of windfoiling without any constraints - effortlessly taking off and enjoying the sensation of flight with minimal effort.

With the forward placement of the widest point, along with a mostly straight rocker extending up to the front foot area, Freefoil rapidly accelerates to its optimal planing speed. Due to its generous width, the board will stay on course and maintain trim even if a sailor is not accurate with his movements or positioning.

For smooth take-offs, the foil box is positioned slightly forward, allowing riders to easily settle into the footstraps and fine-tune the board's trim before ascending into flight.

The deck maintains a flat profile throughout the board, with a slight curve reserved for the footstrap region. This shape encourages a comfortable, natural foot placement on the deck.

During flight, the rear foot is positioned slightly closer to the center line than the front foot, thanks to the narrower tail. Such configuration imparts greater control over the foil's behavior and lift. If the rider should falter, the Freefoil incorporates an ample nose rocker and thoughtfully tucked rails to cushion any abrupt landings.

Designed primarily for progression and recreational freeride foiling, the Freefoil is best when paired with less technical no-cam moderately sized sails.

The HD Alloy Boom is built for riders who want to sail faster, jump higher, and push their kit harder. Increased tube wall thickness delivers superior stiffness and durability over standard aluminium construction — a real step up when sessions get longer and conditions get serious.

The 140 and 160 sizes feature 27 mm diameter grip sections and standard modern tail widths, suited to higher-level freeride, bump and jump, and wave sailing.

The 180 and 200 sizes use wider tails to accommodate deeper sail profiles, with 29 mm diameter grip sections and extra-oversized tails for maximum stiffness under load.

The boom arm curves are shaped for maximum deflection resistance, coming close to matching carbon boom performance at an aluminium price point. All HD models feature anodised tails for improved corrosion resistance.

The HD Alloy Boom is available with a choice of two boom heads:
  • Modular Boom Head — the go-to choice for maximum stiffness and direct mast connection.

  • Ergo Boom Head — a classic single-hinge lever for fast, familiar rigging.
Con #1: On average heavier than Essentials Alloy Booms

Product name: HD Carbon Boom V2 140-200 IWT - Ergo Head
Description:
The HD Carbon Boom V2 brings pre-preg carbon construction into reach. The 70% carbon lay-up delivers a carefully balanced combination of stiffness, durability, and value — way more responsive under load than aluminium, without the price tag of a full carbon boom.

Reinforced tube walls increase resistance to wear and heavy use, helping the boom maintain its structural integrity over time. The result is a stable, composed feel in powered conditions and reliable feedback through gusts and manoeuvres.

Across the full range — from 140–200 to 220–270 — every model features a wide tail designed to support modern sail outlines and deeper profiles without distortion. The sail sets correctly and retains its intended shape, maintaining draft stability when fully powered.

The Inside Wide Tail models offer a compact, direct feel suited to freeride, bump and jump, and wave sailing.

The larger Outside Wide Tail Carbon sizes are developed for bigger freeride and race rigs. By reducing back-end swing weight and distributing load efficiently, they help maintain control and composure at higher speeds.

All HD Carbon Boom V2 booms feature a pulley block for smooth, precise trim adjustments.

The HD Carbon Boom V2 is available with a choice of two boom heads:
  • Modular Boom Head — the go-to choice for maximum stiffness and direct mast connection.

  • Ergo Boom Head — a classic single-hinge lever for fast, familiar rigging.
Con #1: Slightly heavier than the Elite series

Description:
When the priority is the most direct connection between rider and sail, the Modular Boom Head delivers it. Its two-collar construction wraps evenly around the mast, distributing rig loads across the full contact area rather than concentrating them at a single point — resulting in a firm, precise connection that transmits input cleanly and holds its position under load.

Each collar is independently adjustable via ClamCleat® tensioners, allowing fine-tuning for both SDM and RDM masts. The system works with the mast's natural bend curve rather than against it, minimising play and keeping power transfer direct and consistent throughout the session.

The "Direct Fit & Twist" interface makes swapping boom heads a matter of seconds. HD and Elite models accept optional Performance Bolts for riders who want every last percentage of stiffness. Fully compatible with all Unifiber Essentials, HD, and Elite boom bodies — components can be mixed, matched, and replaced individually as needed.

Essentials and HD models are supplied with 4.0mm pre-stretched polyester ropes, while the Elite version features 3.8mm Dyneema ropes.

The Modular Boom Head is available as a standalone or as the boom head of choice when ordering a new Unifiber boom.

Prefer the simplicity of a classic single-hinge boom head? Consider the Unifiber Ergo Boom Head instead.
Pro #1: Direct Fit & Twist functionality requires first-time practice

Description:
Unifiber HD C75 RDM mast range delivers a superb blend of durability and responsiveness that is optimal for many sailors.

With their impressive performance, these masts are a great match for wavesailors, amateur racers and high-wind freeriders looking to step up their game.

HD C75 RDM mast range is introduced in three new specialized curves:
  • Constant Curve — A 'classic' constant curve. Balanced and versatile, with the curve profile that has been preferred by many sailmakers for decades.

As the name says, this mast extension is made for heavy labor.

Whether you sail high-wind racing gear or you like to drop in on some huge waves, this mast extension will survive it all.

The fiber-reinforced nylon base is strong and reliable. Its combination with a carbon tube allows for keeping an overall extension weight low and gives a direct feel between your rig and the board.
Pro #1: 2 pulleys
Pro #2: Carbon tube is more vulnerable to impact damage. So avoid dropping this mast extension on the ground.

The functional length can be adjusted with one hand using the open-and-slide-collar

With their impressive performance, these masts are a great match for wavesailors, amateur racers and high-wind freeriders looking to step up their game.

HD C75 SDM mast range is introduced in three new specialized curves:
  • Constant Curve — A 'classic' constant curve. Balanced and versatile, with the curve profile that has been preferred by many sailmakers for decades.
  • Constant FL Curve — A modern-day flex top with a little more flexing in the centre.
  • Constant FH Curve — Flexes in the top as much as the Green Curve but is a little stiffer in the centre, resulting in a very fluent curve.

Please check our Mast Selector tool to find out what mast curve works best for your rig.

Product name: High Aspect Foil Wing Cover Set 100 - 120 cm
Description:
Our foil bag solution lets you choose which parts of your foil must be protected. The wings? The mast? Both? Configure it yourself!

Foil wings are an essential component of your foiling setup, providing lift and stability during flight. To keep them in pristine condition and prevent damage, it's important to protect them with reliable wing covers.

Our covers feature thick padding and a sturdy outer layer that extends the lifespan of your foil. With 14 size options available, you can easily find the perfect fit for almost any wing.

Our wing covers can be used with a fully assembled foil or when stored separately, providing versatile protection for your gear.
Con #1: Wings with a large wingspan are not completely covered at the center of the wing. If you prefer to have the wings completely covered, but with a little empty space inside the cover, we advise to buy one size larger

Product name: Impulse 5'4 & 3.5 Wing, 1600 Front Wing Foil and Leash
Description:
A complete, ready-to-go wing foiling package suitable for newcomers and experienced recreational wingers.

Features an Impulse 5'4" iFoil board, Aviator wing, Navigator 1600 foil and a leash.

Impulse iFoil is manufactured using a Fusion Composite Dropstitch technology capable of sustaining up to 20 psi of air pressure.

The board is equipped with a carbon plate on the underside to maintain rigidity while in flight.

Product name: Impulse Allround Wing Foil 5'4 (FCD) With Leash
Description:
Impulse wing boards are designed for those looking to start winging and progress quickly!

With their ample width, generous volume and inflatable construction, these boards are super stable under feet and quick to take off.

The nose rocker has an extra kick that makes touchdown softer and safer.

Impulse is built around a long rigid carbon plate positioned under the footstaps area. This technology - combined with Fusion Composite Dropstitch construction - helps the Impulse to achieve a level of stiffness that is more often reserved for composite boards, but with all advantages of an inflatable board.

The deck pad is covered with diamond and directional grooves that provide the rider with maximum grip.

Impulse wing board is supplied with Unifiber Comfort Footstraps that can be bolted into the embedded inserts.

Bigger 6’0 model features a baseplate insert meaning that it can also be used as a windfoiling board.
Pro #1: To prevent possible damage do not use excessive force to roll up your board, and do not put any weight onto the rolled-up board in storage
Pro #2: 6’0 only: Use a cardan type baseplate to connect a windsurf rig

Product name: Impulse Allround Wing Foil Trainer 7'8 (FCD) Leash w/o Pump
Impulse Allround Wing Foil Trainer 7'8 (FCD) With Leash
Description:
Impulse 7’8 is a board dedicated to new arrivals in the world of winging.

Stable and incredibly forgiving, the board setup can be adjusted to match the rider’s progress, allowing for the core skills to be mastered one at a time.

Getting on to the board is the first challenge facing beginners. The Impulse is only 12 cm thick, making it easy to climb aboard even in deep water. An EVA pad with diamond and directional grooves provides the necessary grip and traction, and rider comfort on deck.

Whether the rider is sitting or standing on the board, the inflatable construction and generous volume give Impulse excellent stability.

The ride starts with a three-fin setup, with one fin at the back and a centre fin in the middle. The drag is minimal, and the board can maintain its course. This allows the rider to master wing controls and learn how to interact with the wind.

When it is time for the first real flight, the fins are swapped for a foil setup. Lift-off is smooth and very gentle due to both the board length and the sharp PVC rail edge running around the entire tail area.

As with the other Impulse boards, the 7’8 is built around the long Carbon Composite Skeleton Plate, located directly under rider’s feet.

Combining the Skeleton Plate with a Fusion Composite Dropstitch construction achieves a level of stiffness that is comparable to composite boards.

In flight, Impulse 7’8 remains stable and forgiving. A wide margin for error allows riders to safely practice take-offs, pumping, and tacking manoeuvres.

The board features a baseplate insert meaning that it can also be used as a windfoiling board.

Impulse 7’8 is an ideal board to experience the excitement of flying, and to develop mastery of basic skills, before later moving on to a smaller board.
Pro #1: To prevent possible damage do not use excessive force to roll up your board, and do not put any weight onto the rolled-up board in storage
Pro #2: Use a cardan type baseplate to connect a windsurf rig
Con #1: No bag is supplied.

Welcome to the exciting world of windsurfing exploration! Our specially designed Links are here to support you through every stage of learning, from your initial glides to mastering the art of planning.

With their stable and generously wide shape, coupled with a compact design, our boards are highly accessible and effortless to maneuver. Regardless of your size, we offer a range of boards that are perfectly suited to your needs, providing reassurance and support as you progress in your windsurfing journey. Built with a sturdy molded construction, the Links are resilient against all forms of wear and tear, making them particularly fitted for sailing schools. The deck is fully covered with an EVA pad, offering unparalleled comfort and giving beginners peace of mind in case of a tumble.

Additionally, all our models feature a mast foot insert at the board's nose, allowing you to bring along a child for tandem rides, introducing them to the exhilarating experience of windsurfing with ease.

To enhance versatility, our Link 10' model is equipped with a dedicated foil box, enabling you to use the board for windfoiling and exploring new dimensions of windsurfing possibilities.

Product name: Link V4 AST L & Unifiber Experience EVO Dacron Rig 4.5
Description:
This beginner-focused setup is built for easy starts, steady progress, and a whole lot of fun along the way. The Link V4 and Experience EVO Dacron rig combination gives newcomers a stable platform and a responsive rig. It is ideal for schools, clubs, and first-time riders of any age.

The Link V4 board is shaped with accessibility in mind. A wide, compact outline offers reliable balance, making the first steps less intimidating and more enjoyable. Whether you’re learning to uphaul, steer, or hook into the harness for the first time, the full EVA-covered deck provides soft comfort underfoot and security in case of a fall. The rugged moulded construction handles daily use in school environments, while the tandem mast insert at the nose allows instructors or parents to take kids along for the ride.

The Experience EVO rig is a tried-and-tested companion for learners. Made from durable Dacron, it’s built to last in tough, sandy conditions, and keeps its shape well in both light and gusty winds. A clear layout and colour-coded boom sides make communication easier for instructors, while bright, size-specific colourways help keep group sessions organised on the water. The sail’s balanced outline supports steady learning without overwhelming the rider, and the included bag simplifies storage and transport.

A dependable setup for building confidence and making windsurfing feel accessible, exciting, and cool—right from the first session.

Product name: Link V5 AST L & XO Sails Experience TR Rig ALU 1.0
Description:
The Link V5 AST L and XO Sails Experience TR ALU Rig is a full teaching package designed for schools and clubs guiding beginners from first balance to confident planing. It’s durable, straightforward to use, and supports steady skill-building at every step.

Stable and Practical Board

The Link V5 provides a stable, predictable platform thanks to its wide, compact shape and full EVA deck pad. Riders of all sizes benefit from easy manoeuvrability and secure footing, while coaches get consistent behaviour for efficient instruction. A built-in nose protector guards against rig damage, and a tail wheel insert option makes transporting gear simple—especially for young or small sailors. A tandem insert at the nose allows shared sessions for introducing children to the sport.

Durable Rig for Steady Learning

The Experience TR ALU Rig features a fully-battened Dacron sail with a deep, stable profile for predictable drive. Designed to teach real rigging and tuning skills, it behaves like a no-cam freeride sail and responds well to outhaul and downhaul trimming. Constructed from durable Dacron with a tough PVC window and reinforcements at key points, it’s built to withstand school use.

The rig comes with an aluminium mast, but the option to upgrade to epoxy for extra durability and smoother handling is available.

The Link V5 series is purpose-built to support clubs, schools, and training centres in every stage of windsurfing instruction. From first meters to learning how to plane, these boards provide a stable, accessible platform that helps beginners progress with confidence.

A generously wide shape combined with a compact outline ensures the Link is easy to manoeuvre and reassuringly predictable underfoot. Regardless of rider size or skill level, each board delivers consistent performance that simplifies coaching and accelerates learning.

Built with robust moulded construction, the Link V5 stands up to daily use and the wear and tear of busy teaching environments. The full EVA deck pad offers excellent comfort and safety, while an integrated nose protector beneath the EVA layer shields the board from sail impacts during rig handling and crushes.

For added practicality, the board can also be equipped with a special wheel mounted on the tail, making transport easier even for young sailors moving equipment across sand or uneven ground.

Each model features a mast foot insert at the nose, allowing instructors to introduce children to windsurfing through tandem sessions in a safe and enjoyable way.

Product name: Link V5 With Wheel AST L
Description:
The Link V5 series is purpose-built to support clubs, schools, and training centres in every stage of windsurfing instruction. From first meters to learning how to plane, these boards provide a stable, accessible platform that helps beginners progress with confidence.

A generously wide shape combined with a compact outline ensures the Link is easy to manoeuvre and reassuringly predictable underfoot. Regardless of rider size or skill level, each board delivers consistent performance that simplifies coaching and accelerates learning.

Built with robust moulded construction, the Link V5 stands up to daily use and the wear and tear of busy teaching environments. The full EVA deck pad offers excellent comfort and safety, while an integrated nose protector beneath the EVA layer shields the board from sail impacts during rig handling and crushes.

For added practicality, the board is also equipped with a special wheel mounted on the tail, making transport easier even for young sailors moving equipment across sand or uneven ground.

Each model features a mast foot insert at the nose, allowing instructors to introduce children to windsurfing through tandem sessions in a safe and enjoyable way.

Product name: Loftsails Beachflag 484 x 76 cm - Flag Only
Description: Loftsails Beachflag 484 x 76 cm

Product name: Low Aspect Foil Wing Cover Set 100- 120 cm
Description:
Our foil bag solution lets you choose which parts of your foil must be protected. The wings? The mast? Both? Configure it yourself!

Foil wings are an essential component of your foiling setup, providing lift and stability during flight. To keep them in pristine condition and prevent damage, it's important to protect them with reliable wing covers.

Our covers feature thick padding and a sturdy outer layer that extends the lifespan of your foil. With 14 size options available, you can easily find the perfect fit for almost any wing.

Our wing covers can be used with a fully assembled foil or when stored separately, providing versatile protection for your gear.
Con #1: Wings with a large wingspan are not completely covered at the center of the wing. If you prefer to have the wings completely covered, but with a little empty space inside the cover, we advise to buy one size larger

Description:
The M88 Superfast fins are the most powerful and fastest designed by Select Hydrofoils yet!

The fin’s core structure is crafted from high-modulus carbon, achieving an ultra-thin profile of just 8.8% thickness (8.8 mm for a 10 cm chord). This sleek design minimizes drag in all sailing directions, delivering exceptional speed.

A standout feature of the M88 Superfast fins is the precise balance of flex and twist, known as Active Flex. Thanks to Select's cutting-edge production technology, the trailing edge remains rigid, allowing the leading edge to absorb lateral forces and twist dynamically. This unique design generates a very vertical lift effect, significantly reducing the wetted surface area of the hull for unparalleled comfort and control at high speeds.

Designed for use with speed and slalom boards ranging from 85 to 145 liters, the M88 Superfast fins unlock their full potential in the hands of experienced sailors.
Pro #1: Very sharp trailing edge* > Less drag and enhanced performances

The Maverick is built for riders who want real performance without the extra cost of unnecessary features. In smaller sizes from 4.0 to 5.8 square metres, it’s shaped for low-end Bump & Jump conditions, offering quick response and lively handling. The larger 6.5 and 7.3 sizes deliver straightforward freeride power, perfect for blasting across flat water with confidence.

Its no-nonsense construction keeps weight low, making the sail easy to uphaul and handle. A broad trimming range lets you fine-tune performance across different wind strengths, while monofilm windows provide clear visibility of your surroundings.

The Maverick is fully compatible with the Unifiber x XOsails hardware system, giving you an accessible, dependable setup straight out of the bag. For sailors who want to unlock early planing and better top-end control, upgrading to Unifiber original constant curve masts and booms offers a noticeable boost in feel and response.

The Maverick shares the same proven shape as the Vega, but is intentionally stripped back to keep weight and cost low. Large monofilm panels offer responsive handling but are less durable than bi-ply or X-ply constructions, and to maintain its accessible price, the sail has no mast foot protection and no tack pulleys. These trade-offs make the Maverick an honest, affordable version of a performance sail that delivers the same lively feel as the Vega for riders who prefer simplicity and are ready to rig with care.

Description:
The Nano series of windsurfing boards is a fantastic option for individuals in the beginner to intermediate skill range, who are keen on improving and advancing their skills.

Build with a fairly straight outline and a wide tail to facilitate early and passive planning, these boards possess a forgiving nature that riders of all levels will enjoy.

As riders make strides in their progress, the Nano boards remain highly capable. The design features fine-tuned thin rails and a narrow nose, which makes the board especially easy to gybe.

The larger volume of the Nano boards comes with a retractable daggerboard, which is ideal for progressing in more challenging conditions. This feature allows you to adjust the board to suit your conditions of practice, providing a smooth and stable ride that will help you gain confidence and improve your skills.

On the whole, the Nano series strikes an exceptional balance between quality and affordability, rendering it an excellent investment for newcomers entering the world of windsurfing or aspiring to hone their skills to a new level. With their adaptability, versatility, and durability, the Nano boards bridge the gap between entry-level boards and those preferred by seasoned riders.

Build with a fairly straight outline and a wide tail to facilitate early and passive planning, these boards possess a forgiving nature that riders of all levels will enjoy.

As riders make strides in their progress, the Nano boards remain highly capable. The design features fine-tuned thin rails and a narrow nose, which makes the board especially easy to gybe.

The larger volume of the Nano boards comes with a retractable daggerboard, which is ideal for progressing in more challenging conditions. This feature allows you to adjust the board to suit your conditions of practice, providing a smooth and stable ride that will help you gain confidence and improve your skills.

On the whole, the Nano series strikes an exceptional balance between quality and affordability, rendering it an excellent investment for newcomers entering the world of windsurfing or aspiring to hone their skills to a new level. The Nano series is a dependable choice for beginner to intermediate windsurfers ready to build skills and gain confidence on the water.

Product name: Nano V4 AST 135 & XO Sails Maverick Rig 4.0
Description:
The Nano V4 AST and XO Sails Maverick Rig pairing is made for windsurfers who want to develop skills on reliable gear that feels right from the first tack. It’s a streamlined setup ideal for intermediates, or for sailors looking for dependable freeride performance without unnecessary add-ons.

Stable and Supportive Platform

The Nano V4 AST is a forgiving freeride board that helps sailors unlock early planing and gain confidence. Its straight outline and wide tail offer effortless lift, while the slim rails and narrower nose make turning feel natural as your technique improves. Whether you’re finding the footstraps or mastering smooth gybes, the Nano supports steady, enjoyable progression with a reassuring feel underfoot.

Responsive Rig with a Straightforward Setup

The XO Sails Maverick is designed to deliver real-world performance with a minimalistic build. In smaller sizes from 4.0 to 5.8 square metres, it’s shaped for low-end Bump & Jump conditions, offering quick response and lively handling. The larger 6.5 and 7.3 sizes deliver straightforward freeride power, perfect for blasting across flat water with confidence.

The Maverick is fully compatible with the Unifiber x XOsails hardware system, giving you an accessible, dependable setup straight out of the bag. For sailors who want to unlock early planing and better top-end control, upgrading to Unifiber original constant curve masts and booms offers a noticeable boost in feel and response.

To note: baseplate is not included

Product name: Neon HP & XO Sails Experience TR Rig ALU 1.0
Description:
The Neon HP inflatable freeride board offers solid, planing-ready performance with a forgiving feel, while the Experience TR ALU rig introduces learners to the handling and trim of a full sail setup, without overwhelming complexity.

The Neon HP is an inflatable freeride board made for early progress. It offers excellent stability for uphauling and balance, while its pintail and wide tail encourage quick planing and smooth gybes. Sharp PVC rails reduce drag, and the twinzer fin layout supports shallow-water cruising. Built with Fusion Composite Dropstitch, the board inflates up to 20 psi for added stiffness and responsiveness, then packs down into a compact, wheeled backpack.

The Experience TR ALU Rig features a fully-battened Dacron sail with a deep, stable profile for predictable drive. Designed to teach real rigging and tuning skills, it behaves like a no-cam freeride sail and responds well to outhaul and downhaul trimming. Constructed from durable Dacron with a tough PVC window and reinforcements at key points, it’s built to withstand school use.

The rig comes with an aluminium mast, but the option to upgrade to epoxy for extra durability and smoother handling is available.

Product name: Neon HP & XO Sails Rookie EPX 1.0

The Rookie rig with EPX mast boosts durability without sacrificing control. Its 3D profile keeps power balanced and feedback intuitive, while the epoxy mast absorbs stress and adds stability — especially useful in higher winds or frequent school use. Clear monofilm panels and bright colours add safety and visibility on the water.

Tough, dependable, and designed to grow with the rider, this combo makes learning windsurfing as straightforward as it is fun.

The Neon HP is an inflatable freeride windsurfing board designed for beginners and progressing sailors. Stable, easy to handle, and responsive underfoot, it’s ideal for learning the basics and developing planing skills. The inflatable construction means it sets up quickly and stores in minimal space—perfect for riders who want practical performance with minimal fuss.

With ample volume and a well-balanced shape, the board helps riders uphaul, find balance, and accelerate with confidence. The centre of gravity is positioned at the front footstraps, promoting a natural stance even in light wind. As the board planes, no foot movement is required—your stance is already in place.

A pintail outline and wide tail section encourage early lift and stable gybes, while sharp PVC rails improve water release, reduce drag, and enhance planing efficiency. The twinzer fin setup assists with early planing and shallow-water use, and a centre fin can be added to improve upwind tracking in light wind.

Comfort and grip are built in. A full directional-groove EVA deck pad combines with diamond-pattern zones under the footstraps for secure traction. Raised EVA ridges next to the mast base add grip when uphauling, and a traction disc under the baseplate protects the insert and prevents overtightening.

The High Pressure (HP) construction uses Fusion Composite Dropstitch and can be inflated to 20 psi. This makes the board stiffer, more responsive, and more durable. It comes with an ergonomic backpack that’s compatible with the Unifiber Wheel Base.

Product name: Neon SL & XO Sails Experience TR Rig ALU 1.0
Description:
The Neon SL and Experience TR ALU combo is made for beginners who want to build skills without being held back by their gear. Whether you're just learning the ropes or progressing into planing, this inflatable freeride board and fully-battened rig give you a clear, confidence-building path forward.

The Neon SL offers a stable, forgiving ride that’s quick to plane and easy to handle. Its well-balanced shape helps with balance, uphauling, and maintaining a natural stance. The twinzer fin layout aids early lift and works well in shallower water, while a centre fin can be added to boost upwind performance. The Single Layer construction keeps things lightweight and efficient, inflating to 15 psi and packing easily into an ergonomic backpack.

The Experience TR ALU Rig features a fully-battened Dacron sail with a deep, stable profile for predictable drive. Designed to teach real rigging and tuning skills, it behaves like a no-cam freeride sail and responds well to outhaul and downhaul trimming. Constructed from durable Dacron with a tough PVC window and reinforcements at key points, it’s built to withstand school use.

The rig comes with an aluminium mast, but the option to upgrade to epoxy for extra durability and smoother handling is available.

The footstrap and mounting bolt set can be purchased separately. Available in white and yellow variants.

Description:
Oxygen has built a reputation as one of the most reliable and proven freeride sails on the water with legacy shaped by decades of design refinement and superlative magazine tests.

As a true freeride design, Oxygen simplifies your time on the water. It rigs easily, accelerates quickly, and delivers impressive speed across the course. With a center of effort focused around the rider and smooth, progressive power delivery, the sail naturally settles into a committed stance once you’re in motion.

For 2026, Oxygen evolves again with higher aspect ratios and shorter booms that improve handling and lighten the feel, while re-scheduled luff curves and batten angle re-orientation lowers power and weight distribution, enhancing balance and responsiveness. A slightly lower foot profile adds more punch, especially when fully powered.

All sizes continue to feature multiple tubed battens, typically reserved for competitive designs, adding forward-oriented drive and rock-solid stability in stronger wind. Revised batten specifications further refine this locked-in character, helping the sail deliver both low-wind grunt and clean, efficient performance as conditions build.

Oxygen’s naturally wide wind range is expanded by two clew eyelets: the upper eyelet above the cross-batten powers up the sail in lighter airs, while the lower eyelet below the cross batten makes it easy to depower smoothly when the wind kicks in.

Durability is dialed up for 2026 with new 5mil foot panels. As before, all sizes are offered in two construction variants. The standard version combines a 4.0 mil X-Ply laminate central window and 4.0 mil bi-ply upper body panels. The Oxygen 2026 HD version is constructed with a 4 mil X-Ply laminate central window and 2 mil quad-axial upper panels for added resilience. The Oxygen’s head panels use dual-layer Dacron to improve roll-up ease and enhance long-term durability. A 5.0 mil Kevlar-reinforced laminate clew panel now extends from the clew up to the batten above the boom, prolonging sail life both on the water and in the sailbag.

The new 2026 graphic embodies functional minimalism, reducing unnecessary marker cloth and scrim to lower the sail’s weight center while improving long-term durability.

Finished in this purpose-driven design, Oxygen remains the benchmark for freeriders who want simplicity, speed, and total confidence in all conditions.

Debuting in the year 2000, Oxygen has established itself as a proven and reliable freeride sail with a rich legacy.

As a true freeride sail, Oxygen is designed to simplify the sailing experience. It is easy to set up, accelerates quickly, and delivers impressive speed on the course. With the center of effort focused around the rider and smooth power delivery, once in motion, Oxygen naturally falls back into a committed stance.

However, behind its apparent ease of use lies a true freerace design that can rival the performance of dedicated cam-equipped sails.

The luff curves and leech of Oxygen are meticulously configured to provide a higher range of trim reactivity. This reactivity is key to the sail's expanded performance, allowing it to deliver both low-wind slalom grunt and sleek performance in stronger winds.

To further enhance its upper-end potential, all Oxygens feature tubed batten systems typically found in competitive designs. Selected batten specifications have been revised to provide a more prominent foil-oriented drive.

The natural wind range of Oxygen is already wide, but it is further expanded with the inclusion of two clew eyelets. The upper eyelet above the cross batten powers up the sail for light wind conditions, while the lower eyelet below the cross batten allows for depowering in significantly stronger winds.

Oxygen doesn't compromise on build quality. Just like its previous iterations, all sizes are available in two construction variants. The standard option features 3.5 mil exterior panels, a monofilm central window, and bi-ply upper body panels. The HD version takes it a step further with 3.5 mil exterior panels, a 4 mil xply central window, and 2 mil quad-axial upper body panels.

The Oxygen iWindSUP combines the best of both paddling and windsurfing experiences.

High volume and an allround outline make the Oxygen a friendly board for recreational paddling.

If the wind picks up, the Oxygen iWindSUP features a baseplate insert to convert the SUP into a windsurfer. A special Friction Platform around the insert safeguards against over-tensioning the baseplate.

To improve upwind sailing performance a centre fin may be fitted.

The Oxygen iWindSUP is available in two constructions. The Single Layer version can be pumped to 15 psi. These are light weight and well-made boards with standard performance. The Fusion Composite Dropstitch version can be pumped to 20 psi. These boards have a more direct feel and are super stiff for the best possible performance.
Pro #1: To prevent possible damage do not use excessive force to roll up your board, and do not put any weight onto the rolled-up board in storage
Pro #2: Use a Cardan type baseplate to connect a windsurf rig

Product name: PLKB Cross over bar (with push-away safety)
Description:
Cross Over Control Bar is designed specifically for use with 4-line bridled foil kites and offers advanced features to enhance your kiteboarding experience. With improved control over power and steering, you can confidently navigate various wind conditions and perform dynamic maneuvers with ease.

One of the features of this control bar is the alterable angle of attack during flight. This allows you to regulate the power of your kite by adjusting its angle, giving you greater control and the ability to optimize performance according to your preferences and the prevailing conditions.

Equipped with Ronstan Shock blocks on the brake lines and a Ronstan Orbit 20 Pulley on the front line connection, this control bar ensures smooth and efficient operation. These high-quality components enhance line movement and reduce friction, resulting in improved responsiveness and a more enjoyable riding experience.

Safety is paramount, which is why this control bar is equipped with two primary safety systems. The safety release above the bar allows for quick and easy depower in emergency situations, while the chickenloop with push-away safety provides an additional level of security and quick release capabilities.

For added convenience, the control bar features a self-landing handle. This handle allows you to safely land and secure your kite without assistance, giving you greater independence and ease of use.
